verdict.rationale: Recruitee advertises a 'Pre-onboarding & Onboarding' feature and offers a general API/webhooks system that could theoretically push signed-offer/candidate data to an external HRIS or payroll system, but no evidence names any specific HRIS or payroll integration or describes automatic data hand-off at offer-signature time. Missing for 10: named HRIS/payroll integration partners, documentation of an offer-to-onboarding data sync workflow, and confirmation that fields transfer without re-entry.
